scope: Route 5, Route 6, and Route 7 quality pass
rules: Every audited city must keep all five image slots: hero, history, present, route, and street.
Hero and history slots must prove the city's core story, not generic atmosphere.
Route slots must explain why the city belongs in this route sequence.
Briefed assets are allowed only when the production note clearly names the replacement target.
Generic source homepages are not enough for audited cities; use a specific official or reference page when possible.

daejeon.reason: Daejeon now needs stronger proof than a generic corridor image because Route 8 depends on Sungsimdang, Yuseong, science-city identity, Daejeon Station, and the first southbound split.
daejeon.nextAction: Find or produce separate bakery-street, Yuseong recovery, science-city, station, and route-junction visuals before marking all slots final.

gongju.reason: Baekje gateway needs stronger verified Gongsanseong, royal tomb, Magoksa, river, and old-town imagery.
gongju.nextAction: Replace generic source references with specific VISITKOREA, UNESCO, or public-domain image references.

jeonju.reason: The route depends on Jeonju as the high-confidence food and hanok overnight, so the images must not feel interchangeable.
jeonju.nextAction: Prioritize a real Hanok Village hero and separate food/street references.

gwangju.reason: Gwangju must visually lead with modern Korean history and May 18 civic memory before the culture-city layer.
gwangju.nextAction: Use respectful May 18 memorial imagery for hero/history and keep contemporary culture as the present slot.

imsil.reason: Imsil is a branch stop, so its imagery must make the cheese-country story immediately believable.
imsil.nextAction: Confirm Cheese Theme Park and Okjeongho references before upgrading any slot to ready.

namwon.reason: Namwon has a clear story, but the page needs separate proof for Chunhyang, Gwanghalluwon, Jirisan, and town texture.
namwon.nextAction: Separate garden/story imagery from mountain and street imagery.

suncheon.reason: Suncheon is the ecological hinge before Yeosu, so wetland and garden images need to be specific and distinct.
suncheon.nextAction: Keep wetland as hero/route and National Garden as present; find a street or stay texture image.

yeosu.reason: Yeosu is the finale, so night sea, Odongdo, Hyangiram, seafood, and harbor imagery must not collapse into one generic coast image.
yeosu.nextAction: Prioritize night-sea hero and separate island/temple/food slots.

incheon.reason: Incheon must read as an open-port and West Sea gateway, not only an airport-adjacent city.
incheon.nextAction: Use open-port or Chinatown as hero/history and keep airport/Songdo references secondary.

suwon.reason: Suwon is the UNESCO fortress-planning hinge, so Hwaseong must dominate the image logic.
suwon.nextAction: Upgrade hero/history only after a strong Hwaseong reference is confirmed.

seosan.reason: Seosan is easy to make vague; imagery must prove Haemi, Naepo, Taean access, and food/coast texture.
seosan.nextAction: Find specific Haemi and Taean references before expanding the branch.

boryeong.reason: Boryeong needs both Mud Festival and Daecheon Beach so it does not become only seasonal.
boryeong.nextAction: Pair festival imagery with non-festival beach and stay imagery.

gunsan.reason: Gunsan's colonial-era and modern port history must be handled carefully, with food and street imagery as support.
gunsan.nextAction: Use museum or old port streets as hero/history; avoid cheerful-only treatment.

mokpo.reason: Mokpo is the Route 6 finale, Route 7 handoff, and Route 8 harbor hinge, so harbor, Yudalsan, Gatbawi, ferry, Dadohae, and seafood imagery must be separate.
mokpo.nextAction: Prioritize a harbor/Yudalsan hero and separate Gatbawi, ferry/food, and Haenam handoff references.

haenam.reason: Haenam is both the Route 7 land-end threshold and Route 8 finale, so imagery must prove Ttangkkeut, Duryunsan, Daeheungsa, rural roads, and the Wando continuation rather than generic coast.
haenam.nextAction: Confirm specific land-end, mountain, temple, and route-finale image references before promoting any slot to publish-ready.

wando.reason: Wando needs distinct island, seafood, Cheongsando, Wando Arboretum, and ferry visuals so the route visibly becomes maritime after Haenam.
wando.nextAction: Separate Cheongsando/island imagery from seafood and arboretum imagery before final publication.

boseong.reason: Boseong is visually famous, but the image set must separate Daehan Dawon, green tea culture, rural texture, and the Suncheon handoff.
boseong.nextAction: Use a strong tea-field hero and add distinct tea-culture and street/rural references.

namhae.reason: Namhae must not collapse into generic island scenery; German Village, Boriam, terraces, beaches, and Tongyeong handoff need separate proof.
namhae.nextAction: Find strong German Village and Boriam references, then add road/stay texture.

tongyeong.reason: Tongyeong needs a dense image set that proves Yi Sun-sin memory, Samdo Sugun Tongjeyeong naval history, Hallyeohaesang, ferries, seafood, and the Geoje handoff before Dongpirang becomes the present-day layer.
tongyeong.nextAction: Pair harbor/island imagery with separate Yi Sun-sin or Tongjeyeong history imagery, then use Dongpirang as the modern street layer.

geoje.reason: Geoje has to balance scenic island travel with POW history, shipbuilding, Windy Hill, Oedo, and the final Busan handoff.
geoje.nextAction: Confirm history and modern maritime references separately from scenic island images.
